The '''Debris Cult''' was a religious organization present in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Debris cultists were fanatical scavengers who collected and revered the debris of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

In space, Debris Cult pilots flew [[Kihraxz assault fighter]]s, [[Ixiyen-class fast attack craft|''Ixiyen''-class fast attack crafts]], [[HC-556 Light Cruiser]]s and [[Unidentified Hutt transport model|transports]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateDeathstarDebrisCultist.png|thumb|right|250px|Possible depictions of Debris Cult pilots]]
The Debris Cult appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Debris Cult was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
